brief:
Shehab Wire reported that debris removal operations are accelerating across areas under military control, with rubble being transported out of Gaza as international investigators prepare to enter the territory. The pace of demolition and clearance has intensified even as unidentified bodies remain buried beneath the rubble in multiple locations.

Numerous sites throughout Gaza have not undergone forensic examination, either partially or completely, raising concerns about the preservation of evidence before investigators can access the areas. The removal of debris from locations that have not been criminally inspected complicates efforts to document and investigate conditions on the ground.
